review_description: Michael from Premier Solar took a lot of time to ensure that we were fully informed as to what our system should achieve.

The salesman that came to our house was good. They dropped down a level on value for money and customer service when they rang up three days before installation and told us the price that we have been quoted and paid a deposit on hand which was increased due to a decrease in the REC.
I am hoping to have the solar system installed by the end of the month, together with an Apricus solar hot water system

Unfortunatly none of your leads bothered to contact me I also found not many companies wanted to respond to either emails or phone calls. thanks anyway I think I,ve done the right thing with all your info. Paul
still waitting on a free metre to go inside and my plan change because of the goverment rebate.
